Bihar Cabinet Approves New Universities, Including Women's University

The Bihar Cabinet, chaired by Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary, approved 24 proposals in a meeting. Among these approvals are plans to establish new universities in two districts. Specifically, a women's university named after Maa Sita will be opened in Patna. Other approved proposals cover areas from security to dairy.
